channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Nvidia jumps 7% after blockbuster earnings boost AI confidence
item.description: Nvidia shares rose on Thursday after the chip giant's revenue guidance reassured investors that AI demand will remain strong.

item.title: CIA chief John Ratcliffe reportedly made secretive Moscow trip to warn Russia against attacking NATO
item.description: Russia and Ukraine have intensified long-range drone and missile strikes as fears of further escalation grow.

item.title: Qatari PM heads to Iran to 'de-escalate tensions' as tanker attack tests Trump’s Hormuz claim
item.description: The Prime Minister of U.S.-ally Qatar is in Iran for talks on Thursday as part of efforts to "de-escalate tensions" between Tehran and Washington.

item.title: CrowdStrike jumps 11% on record second quarter as 'Mythos moment' drives AI cyber wave
item.description: CrowdStrike shares have surged 61% this year to new highs as the threat from frontier AI has fueled demand for advanced security tools.

item.title: Why Citi thinks one of the year's best-performing sectors is finishing its bull run
item.description: European banks have shaken off a weak first quarter to notch solid share price gains in the year to date, but Citi analysts warn their momentum may be fading.

item.title: Fed Gov Lisa Cook’s lawyer fires back at Trump's renewed threat to oust her
item.description: The Supreme Court in late June blocked Trump from firing Cook from the Federal Reserve, but left the president with a path to try again to remove her.

item.title: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says the ‘SaaSpocalypse’ is nonsense. Here's why
item.description: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff pushed back against “SaaSpocalypse” fears.

item.title: Federal judge lifts final block on Trump mail-in voting order, clearing way for midterm restrictions
item.description: The rule in question would require election officials to give USPS voter information and use federally reviewed, uniquely barcoded ballot envelopes.

item.title: Nasdaq futures jump as Nvidia earnings lift chip stocks: Live updates
item.description: Global investors are reacting to the earnings report from Nvidia, which surpassed analyst forecasts.

item.title: Republicans are dismissing affordability. That could be a problem in November
item.description: President Donald Trump quipped that affordability was "devised" by Democrats, while Vice President JD Vance said groceries "cost what they cost."

item.title: The post-penny economy: How cash rounding and credit card surcharges are changing what you pay
item.description: More merchants are rounding change for cash purchases to the nearest nickel due to the end of penny production, or adding surcharges to credit card transactions.

item.title: The toy industry's latest craze is cheap, colorful and very squishy
item.description: Squishy toys are booming, with social media and low prices helping fuel the craze.

item.title: OpenAI releases sweeping report on Hugging Face AI agent hack
item.description: The 37-page report walks through the actions that OpenAI's models took during a series of evaluations prior to and during the Hugging Face breach.

item.title: Anthropic and Nscale strike $45 billion cloud deal, sources say
item.description: Anthropic will rent around 460 megawatts of compute capacity at an Nscale data center development in West Virgina, according to sources.

item.title: Economists want Warsh to share more on his view of the economy at Jackson Hole, says CNBC survey
item.description: Eighty percent of CNBC Fed Survey respondents say the Federal Reserve Chairman Warsh should provide more insight into his economic views.

item.title: U.S. still watching allies for alignment of interests even amid defense pullback, analyst says
item.description: The U.S. may be asking allies to step up their own defense, but it still wants them to align on geopolitical interests.

item.title: Z.ai shares surge 8% after releasing new AI model running only on Chinese chips
item.description: The Chinese AI company said it had already launched the model globally in stealth mode for a week.

item.title: Bitcoin’s macro case is strengthening even as regulation takes a back seat, says BlackRock’s digital assets head
item.description: The flagship cryptocurrency's recent rally parallels its history of rebounding whenever investor sentiment toward other assets cools, says BlackRock's Mitchnick.

item.title: Okta pops 20% after topping estimates as AI threat spikes demand for identity security
item.description: New products accounted for 30% of total bookings and Okta said it closed dozens of AI deals during the period

item.title: Treasury yields are running hot. Here are opportunities for income-seeking investors
item.description: Long-dated Treasury yields hit key levels last week. Investors can turn up attractive income amid the volatility.

item.title: Europe’s gas stores are running low — and prices could top 100 euros this winter
item.description: Europe’s gas stores are historically low for this time of year, as disrupted Middle East LNG flows raise the risk of sharply higher prices this winter.

item.title: Gen Z is turning their side hustles into businesses. These financial tools can help
item.description: Four financial products can help Gen Z entrepreneurs make their business official, cover startup costs, separate finances and build business credit.

item.title: Jensen Huang defends Nvidia's growing financial support for AI ecosystem, says 'the risk is low'
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang defended the chipmaker’s growing role in financing AI companies, calling its investments a “once in a generation” opportunity.

item.title: Qantas shares jump after earnings as airline unveils new business-class seats
item.description: Qantas shares jumped 4% after the airline reported full-year earnings and introduced new business-class seats amid strong demand for premium travel.

item.title: China industrial profits growth cools to slowest in seven months as economic slowdown deepens
item.description: China's industrial profits growth in July slowed to its weakest pace this year, as soft demand and a broader slowdown in the economy weighed on manufacturers.

item.title: Hundreds missing after flood hits Nepal-Tibet border, 157 bodies recovered
item.description: A glacier-rock collapse triggered catastrophic Nepal–Tibet border floods, killing at least 157 people and leaving hundreds of tourists missing.

item.title: Bank of Korea delivers back-to-back rate hikes as core inflation stays elevated
item.description: The Bank of Korea hiked rates by 25 basis points to 3%, its highest since January 2025 and in line with expectations.

item.title: Japanese startups, IPOs set for boost with platform to trade unlisted companies
item.description: The Japanese regulator's registration of a new trading platform for unlisted shares could help create a more favorable capital-raising environment for the country's IPO ecosystem.

item.title: Salesforce, Anthropic expand partnership as Benioff responds to ‘SaaSpocalypse’ concerns
item.description: "We're delivering a dynamic interface that thinks, reasons, and acts," Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff said in a statement.

item.title: Thursday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
item.description: The S&P 500 closed Wednesday not too far from where it began as investors waited for Nvidia to post its results. The chipmaker's stock was higher after hours.
